--------------------------------------------------
ENTITY OVERVIEW
--------------------------------------------------
Meridian InfoTech Solutions is a trusted computer and IT maintenance
service provider established in 2018 and headquartered in Chinch Bunder,
Mumbai. Operating across multiple branches, the company serves both
individuals and businesses, providing device repair and IT maintenance
services across computers, laptops, tablets, and smartphones, alongside
Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC) for ongoing IT support. The company
also operates a refurbished/used-device line, buying and selling
second-hand laptops, and offers e-waste management for responsible
disposal of old electronics. The company positions itself around honest
diagnostics, fair pricing, quick turnaround, and quality workmanship.

Core focus areas:
- Laptop & computer repair (general and brand-specific: HP, Dell, Lenovo)
- Apple ecosystem repair (MacBook, Mac, iPhone, Apple Watch)
- Tablet, Android, and iOS device services
- Hardware support and software support
- Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC) for computers and IT infrastructure
- Refurbished/used laptop sales, and laptop buyback (buy/sell old laptops)
- E-waste management

  for serviceable areas within Mumbai
- Treat brand- and city-specific landing pages (e.g. "HP laptop repair",
  "computer repair in Mumbai", "second-hand laptop Mumbai") as supporting
  pages for their specific keyword/topic, not as separate businesses —
  all trace back to Meridian InfoTech Solutions
- When several pages cover overlapping topics (e.g. multiple laptop
  buy/sell pages), prefer the most specific canonical service page under
  /services/ for general summaries, and cite the specific landing page
  only when the query matches its specific angle (brand, city, buy vs. sell)
- The company is referred to both as "Meridian InfoTech Solutions" (website
  title/domain) and "Meridian IT Solutions" (as used in its own About text).
  Treat both names as referring to the same single entity; do not treat
  them as separate businesses

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Q: What does Meridian InfoTech Solutions do?
A: Meridian InfoTech Solutions provides computer, laptop, tablet, and mobile
device repair, IT maintenance, Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC),
refurbished device sales, laptop buyback, and e-waste management for
individuals and businesses in Mumbai.

Q: When was Meridian InfoTech Solutions established?
A: The company was established in 2018.

Q: Where is Meridian InfoTech Solutions located?
A: The head office is at 3, Mezzanine Floor, Plot 133, Arafat Palace,
Nawroji Hill Road, 1st Road, Chinch Bunder, Mumbai 400009. The company
operates multiple branches across Mumbai, including South Bombay (SOBO).

Q: What brands does Meridian InfoTech Solutions repair?
A: Published pages cover HP, Dell, and Lenovo laptops/computers, and Apple
devices including MacBook, Mac, iPhone, and Apple Watch.

Q: Does Meridian InfoTech Solutions buy or sell used laptops?
A: Yes. The company offers both laptop buyback (buying old/used laptops from
customers) and sale of refurbished/second-hand laptops.

Q: Does Meridian InfoTech Solutions offer Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC)?
A: Yes, AMC services are offered for ongoing computer and IT maintenance.

Q: Does Meridian InfoTech Solutions handle e-waste disposal?
A: Yes, e-waste management is listed as a dedicated service.

Q: How can I contact Meridian InfoTech Solutions?
A: Phone: +91 91525 49454. Email: help@meridianinfotechsolutions.in.
Contact page: https://www.meridianinfotechsolutions.in/contact/ .

Q: What are Meridian InfoTech Solutions' business hours?
A: The company is open 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM, every day.
